scope: 48 mots du carnet, épisodes 1 et 2 ; 4 aquarelles de V0.6.2 conservées, 44 nouvelles
commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square watercolor vocabulary vignette for a Mandarin learning notebook. Delicate hand-painted watercolor on warm ivory paper, airy edges fading into empty ivory, jade and coral palette, spare composition readable at 96px. Only show subjects explicitly requested in the scene, no extra people, portraits, ghost figures, decorative faces or dragons. When present, Mei has dark messy bun, red ribbons and red cloak; elderly Master Chen has white bun and beard and gold ochre robe; Long is a green Chinese dragon with gold horns and mane. Reference images define appearances only, do not reproduce unrequested characters. Never show the customizable player hero. Absolutely no text, letters, Chinese characters, numbers, labels, punctuation, speech bubbles, borders or watermark. The scene is a memory cue for a word, not a comic panel or character etymology.
